Messages.Author: Sambomb
Messages.Body:
Related rules:
www.vekn.net/detailed-play-summary
INFLUENCE PHASE [7] Gain Transfers (a.k.a. "Influence Phase Actions"). On turns 1, 2, and 3, gain only 1, 2, or 3 transfers, respectively. Each turn after the third, gain exactly 4 transfers. You may spend your transfers in any combination of the following: 1: move one of your pool to one of your uncontrolled minions. 2: move one blood from one of your uncontrolled minions to your pool. 4: burn one pool and move the top card from your crypt to your uncontrolled region. 4: burn one pool to merge a vampire in your uncontrolled region with a vampire you control (the base and advanced versions). [1.5.6] Any remaining transfers are lost. Any uncontrolled vampires (minions) with blood equal or greater than their blood capacity (cost) become controlled and move to the ready region unlocked. Excess counters drain off.

If I have Information Highway in play and in my uncontroled region:
6 counters on Tariq, the Silent ( ADV ), 0 on Tariq, the Silent ( basic version ), 1 in a Anarch Convert, 0 in another Anarch Convert.
Can I spend, 1 transfer to influence Tariq ( ADV), 4 transfers to merge it, 1 transfer to bring the 0 counter Anarch Convert to play transforming Tariq ( Merged ) in anarch? Can I spend, 1 transfer to influence Tariq ( ADV), bring the Anarch Convert with 1 counter to play transforming Tariq ( ADV ) in anarch and after it, 4 transfers to merge and finally 1 transfer to bring the other Anarch Convert to play transforming Tariq ( Merged ) in anarch? The "merged" before influence phase end Tariq lose 4 blood because of the non merged text?

Archbishop of Itaocara
Prince ID #510

Messages.Author: Timo
Messages.Body:
First it costs no transfer to bring an influenced minion into play.

Then if I am correct, you can bring a full Tariq in play during your influence phase. At this time Tariq is controlled and is not merged so his capacity is reduced by his card text. So you lose blood accordingly.

You can bring a full Convert in play and then using (or not) his text to make Tariq Anarch.

You can then use 4 transfers to merge Tariq (and gain no blood for it). And bring another full Convert into play. Chosing (or not) to make Tariq (merged) Anarch.

Messages.Author: Hakuron
Messages.Body:
The rulebook answers your last question:
The advancement card is a vampire card in all respects, so it can be influenced in the normal manner. In addition, if you already control the advancement or the associated regular "base" vampire and the other version of the vampire is in your uncontrolled region, then you can spend 4 transfers and 1 pool to move the vampire card from your uncontrolled region to the controlled vampire card (place the advancement card on top of the base card). The two cards effectively merge to form a single vampire.

Merging happens when a controlled (!) vampire meets his counterpart.

National Coordinator Germany  nc [dot] germany [at] magenta [dot] de

Messages.Author: kschaefer
Messages.Body:
> Sambomb wrote:
> Can I spend, 1 transfer to influence Tariq ( ADV), 4 transfers to merge it, 1 transfer to bring the 0 counter Anarch Convert to play transforming Tariq ( Merged ) in anarch? Can I spend, 1 transfer to influence Tariq ( ADV), bring the Anarch Convert with 1 counter to play transforming Tariq ( ADV ) in anarch and after it, 4 transfers to merge and finally 1 transfer to bring the other Anarch Convert to play transforming Tariq ( Merged ) in anarch? The "merged" before influence phase end Tariq lose 4 blood because of the non merged text?
>
You can order your influence in any way that you want and are no longer required to bring any minions into play even if they have enough counters to be controlled.

Therefore:
1. You have 6 transfers. You can do this. You will end up with a 7-capacity vampire that has 3 blood and is Anarch.
2. You have 6 transfers you can do this. You will end up with a 7-capacity vampire that has 3 blood and is Anarch. Note: nothing prevents you from using an Anarch Convert on a vampire that is already an Anarch, so this rigamarole to use two AC is not necessary. You could use both of them at the end, if you wanted.
3. Yes, he will lose 4 blood. There is a definite order and it does not matter which Tariq is first. He becomes a 3-capacity vampire and the excess will go to the blood bank. All of that must be resolve before you can merge him.

Messages.Author: Timo
Messages.Body:
> Mewcat wrote:
> 2 related questions that came up the other day:
>
> Banished minion with skill card. Capacity x. Can x + 1 blood be placed and remain after influence.
>
> Merged minion with different capacity is banished. What is the capacity of uncontrolled minion? Same over influence question as before.
>
Every card on a vampire in your uncontrolled region is out of game so it doesn't change your vampire capacity. So you can choose to place x counters on him and put him back in the ready region. You could also place X+1 blood and he would come in the ready region with X+1 blood. Once controlled, the game will check if the vampire have too many blood and will see a controlled vampire with a capacity of X+1 and no excess blood.

For the second question, I am not sure because I can't find the rules about merged vampires. But IIRC once merged, the vampire take every trait from the advanced version plus the text of the base version and the merged version.

So a vampire with a 7 capacity base and an 8 capacity advanced will be an 8 capacity merged. And the game remember it has been merged so if you want to influence him back, you will need to put 8 counters on him (and an 8 capacity vampire will not be able to put blood counter on him using cards like Govern the Unaligned).

Not quite: "Independent: Valerius becomes non-infernal and non-Red List as he merges."
The change is one-shot and permanent ("becomes"). If for some reason his text were blank after he merged, he would still be non-infernal and non-Red List. While uncontrolled, it's the same.
A vampire becoming Anarch using the rulebook action would still be Anarch while uncontrolled. Barbaro Lucchese who would change clan would be Tremere antitribu while uncontrolled.

Also, a vampire keeps his traits while uncontrolled, I think it should be clarified in the rulebook.
